name: Aeolus
author: diogocezar
description: Quiet, temperature-driven control of your motherboard's fan headers (case fans, radiator fans and liquid cooler pump) from the Omarchy bar. Auto keeps the CPU under a target with the least noise; Silent, Performance and a manual speed slider too. A small root service does the driving, with safety rails: full speed when hot, a floor the pump never goes under, and the motherboard's own curves back whenever the service stops.

barWidget.description: Fan control: temperature, modes and fan speed
